title: Pricing Event Type - Data API
description: Pricing events contain information about pricing procedures that were executed, including details such as pricing procedures used, the pricing APIs, and pricing details and status.

CLIENT_IP.description: The IP address of the client that’s using Salesforce services. A Salesforce internal IP (such as a login from AppExchange) is shown as “Salesforce.com IP”. If the user’s session context isn't available, this field returns a blank value.

CPU_TIME.description: The CPU time in milliseconds used to complete the request. This field indicates the amount of activity taking place in the app server layer.

EVENT_TYPE.description: The type of event. The value is always Pricing.

LOGIN_KEY.description: The string that ties together all events in a given user’s login session. It starts with a login event and ends with either a logout event or the user session expiring.

ORGANIZATION_ID.description: The 15-character ID of the organization. For example: 00D000000000062.

PRICING_API_ENDPOINT.description: The starting point of the Pricing API or Headless Pricing API. For example: Pricing API.

PRICING_DETAILS.description: The details of the pricing event that describes if the pricing API was executed or failed. For example: Pricing element was processed..

PRICING_ERROR_CODE.description: The API error code that appears when pricing execution fails. If there is no error, the value is null. For example: INTERNAL_ERROR.

PRICING_LOG_NAME.description: The detailed pricing log message generated. For example: The Headless Pricing API was run in:{0}.

PRICING_PROCEDURE.description: The name of the pricing procedure used to perform pricing calculations. For example: Default Pricing Procedure.

PRICING_STATUS.description: The status of the request for pricing execution. For example: Completed or Failed.

REQUEST_ID.description: The unique ID of a single transaction. A transaction can contain one or more events. Each event in a given transaction has the same REQUEST_ID.

RUN_TIME.description: The amount of time that the request took in milliseconds. For example: 1851629863.

SESSION_KEY.description: The user’s unique session ID. You can use this value to identify all user events within a session. When a user logs out and logs in again, a new session is started.

TIMESTAMP.description: The time that the pricing was executed in GMT. For example: 20170606170000.000.

TIMESTAMP_DERIVED.description: The time that the pricing was executed in ISO8601-compatible format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ). For example: 2017-06-06T1700.000Z. Timezone is GMT.

URI.description: The URI of the page that’s receiving the request. For example: /home/home.jsp.

URI_ID_DERIVED.description: The 18-character case insensitive ID of the URI of the page that’s receiving the request.

USER_ID.description: The 15-character ID of the user who executed pricing through the UI or the API. For example: 005SG000000eu6j

USER_ID_DERIVED.description: The 18-character case insensitive ID of the user who’s using Salesforce services through the UI or the API. For example: 001xx0000000useAAA.
